newsitem.title: PANAMA: Duff & Phelps to launch Central America service.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps to launch Central America service.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co will establish a regional rating agency in Central America soon, Panama's stock exchange director said Wednesday.
The deal is part of a joint venture with the Central American Exchange Association and the International Finance Corporation, the financial arm of the World Bank, Roberto Brenes said.
"The rating agency will be established soon and will have a presence throughout the region. We are still working out the administrative details and the number of offices," he said.
The name of the company has not been established, he said.
"There's a great need to have a reputable rating agency in the area for foreign and regional investors," he said.
Issues from banks, private companies and government institutions will be rated, he said.
Brenes said ratings are becoming increasingly essential in Central America, particularly for pension funds and social security institutions undergoing privatizations.
